subject: Part 5 not appearing in scored results

messages.author: a8f5c8b718f02ab5
messages.subject: Part 5 not appearing in scored results
parts:
Hi there, 

Recently, the code I have previously used to score GENEActiv files threw me an error. The code and error are in Appendix A. Until this week, this code had successfully worked. I tried changing "def.noc.sleep = c()" and the code ran. However,  the output I got was missing the part5_daysummary and part5_personsummary files (Screenshot in Appendix B as attachment). 

Can you please help me troubleshoot why part5_daysummary and part5_personsummary files are not appearing and how I can fix that? Thank you so much for your help.

Best,
Sidney


Appendix A
g.shell.GGIR(
  datadir="C:/Users/..../PulledOn20220412",
  outputdir="C:/Users/..../ScoredOn20220414",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
  windowsizes=c(5,900,3600),
  do.cal=TRUE,
  do.enmo=TRUE,
  do.anglez=TRUE,
  chunksize=1,
  printsummary=TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 2,
  hrs.del.start = 0,
  hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 9,
  includedaycrit = 16, #minimum number of hours of wear to do analysis
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  mvpathreshold =c(100,120),
  bout.metric = 4,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  #=====================
  # Part 3
  #=====================
  timethreshold = c(5,10),
  anglethreshold=5,
  ignorenonwear= TRUE, #so non wear is not included as sleep
  #=====================
  # Part 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = FALSE, 
  outliers.only = FALSE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  loglocation="C:/Users/.../SleepLogBaseline2022APR12.csv",
  relyonguider=FALSE,
  sleeplogidnum=FALSE,
  colid=1,
  coln1=2,
  nnights=7,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

Error in check_class("Sleep", params = params_sleep, parnames = numeric_params,  :
 
Sleep argument def.noc.sleep is not numeric

Error in check_class("Sleep", params = params_sleep, parnames = numeric_params,  :
 
Sleep argument def.noc.sleep is not numeric

Maybe this relates to the config.csv file. 

Can you try:

  • remove output folder to start fresh
  • reinstall GGIR
  • if you were using a configfile as input argument then comment it out
  • process the file again

If that does not work:
  • install development version of GGIR (guidance)

Vincent
